explanation: A golden crown made for Joshua the priest as a sign of the coming King from David's line.
The high priest who received the crown and represented the future Messiah in the prophecy.
Symbol of a person who will grow up from his place and build the Lord's temple.
God's house that will be rebuilt, which will happen with the help of the coming King.
The act where sin is taken away from the land in one day through the coming ruler.
A reference to the exiled Jews returning home and participating in God's plan.
The prophecy that God will build his temple, which requires faith in the unseen work.
